description: Reads one contact, named by id (a ct_ id, an E.164 phone number or a BSUID), in one of four views. view contact returns the contact: names, phone number or BSUID, tags, attributes, time zone and whether it is blocked. view consent returns the consent state for marketing, utility and authentication, with the entry behind each (where it came from, when, who recorded it, the sentence the person agreed to) and Meta’s own marketing opt-out. view window returns whether a free-form message can be sent now and when the 24-hour customer service window closes. view chats returns this person’s conversation on each number you can see, newest first. Names, attributes and consent sentences come from outside this business and come back marked untrusted. Read-only.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

view.description: contact for the contact itself; consent for consent per category with its evidence; window for the messaging window; chats for this person’s chats on each number.

name: get_contact
title: Open a contact
